VALIDATING.message: Validating selected inputs and output options.

COLLECTING.message: Collecting selected inputs locally; no project commands are executed.

SYFT_DOWNLOADING.message: Downloading the approved, pinned Syft archive from GitHub.

SYFT_RUNNING.message: Scanning existing application files with verified Syft.

CHECKING.message: Waiting for Monitor to check the inventory; saved assets are unchanged.

SYNCING.message: Synchronizing only the credential's configured source.

SAVING.message: Saving results to a new private file.

API_RETRY.message: Retrying a temporary API failure within the existing request deadline.

STILL_WORKING.message: Still working; the operation deadline remains active.

SYFT_CACHE_VERIFIED.message: Pinned Syft archive found in cache and its checksum verified.

SYFT_DOWNLOAD_VERIFIED.message: Downloaded Syft archive passed pinned checksum verification.

SOURCE_STATE.message: Reading the current source revision before synchronization.

API_RESPONSE_VALIDATED.message: API response format, completeness and submitted-component consistency verified.

OFFLINE_COLLECTION.message: Native collection uses no network or credentials.

SYFT_ISOLATION.message: Syft runs with fixed offline configuration and a restricted environment; this is not an OS sandbox.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIAL: Monitor rejected the credential. It may be invalid, expired or revoked; create a new credential and replace the protected file.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: This credential does not permit the requested operation. Use Check only for check, or Sync only / Check and sync for sync.
errors.ACCESS_REVOKED: Monitor access is no longer authorized. Ask the account administrator to review subscription and membership permissions.
errors.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The configured source is unavailable. Review it in Settings > Assets and create a credential for an active source.
errors.RESOURCE_NOT_AUTHORIZED: The credential does not authorize this application/source. Use the credential issued for the intended destination.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Monitor rate limit reached. Stagger operations for this account and retry later.
errors.INVENTORY_CONFLICT: The source changed during synchronization. Review its current inventory before starting a new sync.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: The retry key was reused with a different request. Inspect the source before starting a new sync.
errors.DISTRIBUTION_CATALOG_INVALID: The distribution catalog is unavailable or invalid. Retry the check later; no successful assessment is reported.
errors.DISTRIBUTION_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: The distribution catalog is unavailable. Retry later; no successful assessment is reported.
errors.DISTRIBUTION_CATALOG_STALE: The distribution catalog is out of date. Retry after it is refreshed; no successful assessment is reported.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Monitor is temporarily unavailable. Retry later; a sync may already have committed, so inspect the source first.
errors.SCANNER_PAUSED: Monitor scanner operations are temporarily paused. Retry later.
errors.INVENTORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The inventory exceeds the account limit. Review selected inputs and account capacity.
errors.REQUEST_REJECTED: Monitor rejected the request. Review the operation, credential permissions and account limits.
errors.API_TRANSPORT_FAILED: Could not reach Monitor over HTTPS. Check connectivity; a sync may already have committed, so inspect the source first.
errors.REMOTE_FAILED: The API operation could not be confirmed. Review the credential, inventory and service availability; inspect the source before retrying sync.
errors.INVALID_INVENTORY: The inventory is invalid. Use an Awarely inventory.cdx.json containing a components array, or import a supported external SBOM first.
errors.CREDENTIAL_FILE_INVALID: The credential file could not be validated. Check its JSON format, ownership and owner-only permissions (chmod 600).
errors.PARTIAL_SYNC: Synchronization requires complete selected-input coverage. Use local export or check, or collect installed dependencies.
errors.EMPTY_SYNC: An empty inventory would remove this source's components. Review it and use --allow-empty only for intentional clearing.
errors.INTERRUPTED: The operation was interrupted or exceeded its deadline. A sync may already have committed; inspect the source before retrying.
errors.OUTPUT_FAILED: Results could not be saved. Choose a new file in a writable directory; an API sync may already have committed.
errors.COLLECTION_FAILED: Collection failed. Review the selected path, supported manifests or built artifacts and tool availability; nothing was uploaded.
